instruction_summary: Fit a low-power 'law per era' over 002's 5-model ladder: regress persona-vector steering effect size and projection-monitoring r on size/era/layer-depth/alignment-style, test whether the effective steering layer is era-invariant, measure cross-family persona-direction cosine alignment, flag the reasoning-distilled DeepSeek deviation, and state the updated claim. CPU-only reuse of 002 artifacts; no models or judge calls re-run.

steps.description: Read 002's tidy long table + aggregate.json (baseline C5, selected layer, steering effect, monitoring r C2, separability AUC C13, C1 curves, era/release/n_layers) as read-only inputs.
Built 15-row per-(model,trait) analysis table, joining 002 measurements with fixed public model-card metadata (params, hidden dim, family, alignment style).

Analysis 1&4: univariate + multivariate OLS of steering effect and monitoring r on log-params/era/depth-fraction/alignment; era-invariance test of depth-fraction; parametric monitoring law + per-era logistic steering dose-response.
Analysis 2: cross-model cosine of persona vectors at each model's selected layer, restricted to same-hidden-dim (4096) set; same-vs-cross-family comparison + matched-layer robustness.
Rendered transfer heatmap, partial/marginal-dependence panel, and depth-invariance + DeepSeek-deviation figure.

key_results.depth_fraction_era_invariant: selected-layer depth-fraction vs era slope +0.005 (p=0.79, R2=0.006); mean 0.552 +/- 0.099, range 0.44-0.71 -> era-invariant late-layer locus
key_results.layer_depth_is_the_predictor: depth-fraction is the one robust continuous predictor of BOTH steering effect (slope +123, R2=0.33, p=0.024) and monitoring r (slope +1.31, R2=0.33, p=0.025)
key_results.era_not_significant: era slope on steering Delta -2.4 (p=0.55) and on monitoring r -0.066 (p=0.11); neither significant once DeepSeek is seen as an alignment-style outlier
key_results.size_untestable: all 5 models 7.24-8.19B; log-params slopes non-significant (p>0.3) - no size law obtainable
key_results.alignment_governs_monitoring: monitoring r one-way ANOVA F=27.7 p<0.001; means base-RLHF 0.919 / newer-RLHF 0.842 / reasoning-distill 0.393; multivariate reasoning-distill dummy -0.524 (p=0.015, model R2=0.85)
key_results.cross_family_cosine: same-family (Llama<->DeepSeek) mean cosine 0.478 (0.37-0.57 own layers, up to 0.73 matched layer) vs cross-family 0.002 (-0.019..+0.029) -> ~200x within-family alignment; raw cross-arch cosine ~0 reflects basis non-alignment
key_results.deepseek_deviation: DeepSeek-R1-Distill outlier on monitoring r (0.25-0.48), steering Delta (16-71), logistic fit (R2=0.33, midpoint 1.73 vs ~1.2), selected depth (0.44), inflated baseline hallucination (72.2); separability C13 AUC>=0.996 unaffected; <think>-token caveat
key_results.parametric_laws: monitoring r ~ 0.232 - 0.074*era + 1.398*depth_frac (R2=0.56); steering half-max coefficient era-stable ~1.2 (midpoint-vs-era slope -0.023, p=0.86)

comparison_to_original.note: Confirms landscape hypothesis of a stable ~0.55 late-layer locus regardless of generation.

comparison_to_original.followup: era slope -0.066 (p=0.11, ns); alignment ANOVA F=27.7 (p<0.001)
comparison_to_original.note: Governed by alignment style (reasoning-distill collapse), not by era or size.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Steering effect size (Delta over baseline) across ladder
comparison_to_original.followup: depth slope +123 (R2=0.33, p=0.024); logistic half-max coef era-stable ~1.2
comparison_to_original.note: Large and roughly flat across generation; depends more on layer-depth than era.
The one qualitative break; property of the reasoning-distill recipe, not of 2025.

comparison_to_original.original: persona vectors on disk (.pt), not previously compared across models
comparison_to_original.note: Directions align within architecture family (shared basis) but not across independently-trained families.

deviations: No GPU in this environment (nvidia-smi -> 'No devices found'), so the OPTIONAL portability confirmation generation (analysis 2) was not run; study stays 0 GPU / 0 judge per default guardrail. Transfer answered by cosine geometry only.

Low statistical power stated explicitly: 5 models = 5 eras (era 1:1 with model, partly confounded with alignment); 15 model x trait points cluster into 5 model-level draws; all regressions are descriptive, not confirmatory (multivariate condition number ~1.7e4).
Model size untested: all 5 models are 7.24-8.19B so log-params has near-zero variance; no size law obtainable on this ladder.

Cross-family cosine limited to same-hidden-dim (4096) models (Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen3); Qwen2.5 (3584) excluded rather than fabricating cross-dim alignment. Raw cross-arch cosine ~0 reflects basis non-alignment, not conceptual dissimilarity.

Alignment-style labels are the analyst's mapping onto the instruction's three levels; DeepSeek's deviation is equally describable as reasoning-distill recipe or era-4 point (data cannot separate them).
